title: User Management
description: Members + invites surface ported from superspace, props-driven + RBAC-agnostic. <MembersPanel>: searchable / role-filterable / sortable member table (avatar + name + email), inline role dropdown, soft-remove, an InviteDialog (email + role + message) and a PendingInvites list with resend / cancel — all permission-gated. You pass `roles` + `currentPerms` (resolved from rbac-roles) + CRUD/invite callbacks; the slice imports no other slice's frontend. Convex template ships um_members + um_invites + listMembers/listInvites + addMember/updateMemberRole/removeMember + sendInvite/cancelInvite/resendInvite/acceptInvite (7-day token), all gated via rbac-roles' requirePermission. P1+P2 of the user-management epic — roles admin (P3) next.

peers.reason: Roles + resolved permissions + the convex permission helpers (requirePermission, getActorPermissions).
Member identity (name/email/avatar) joined from the users table.
